annotation.title_clean: Framework of ethical aspects of artificial intelligence, robotics and related technologies: European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission (2020/2012(INL))
annotation.title_en: Framework of ethical aspects of artificial intelligence, robotics and related technologies: European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission (2020/2012(INL))
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 404/63
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution requesting a Commission legislative proposal for a Regulation on ethical principles for AI, robotics and related technologies. It proposes a risk-based framework with high-risk sector lists, mandatory human oversight, national supervisory authorities, a European ethical-compliance certificate, and includes draft regulation text plus defence and transport provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Requests a Regulation on ethical principles for AI, robotics and related technologies under Article 114 TFEU
Exhaustive, cumulative list of high-risk sectors and uses (transport, defence, healthcare, automated driving, autonomous military systems)
High-risk technologies must allow full human oversight and regaining control, including halting
National supervisory authorities assess risk and compliance and issue a European certificate of ethical compliance
Calls for international ban on lethal autonomous weapons without meaningful human control
